Print at 100% scale (no "fit to page"); the code must measure 18 cm per side — the bridge uses that size to estimate marker position. Lay it flat in an open, well-lit spot, away from glare.

Select Forecast Contour in Live for this scenario. The marker identifies the general fire area; the separate flight runtime follows GPS forecast coordinates. A tiny scenario does not imply centimetre-accurate GPS.
